parsed.text: Panel p0 current: nodes n0, n1 and n2 are copied from prior records and show uniform 4x4 distributions for both red and blue. Panel p0 current node n3 shows blue concentrated at cell (1,0) and red at (1,2). Candidate command records for p0 (k0, k1, k2) place node n2 consistently with blue peak at (0,2) and red peak at (0,1) while their peak probabilities differ; those candidate records are conditional estimates, not executed events. Panel p1 current: most nodes are copied completed records and uniform. Candidate records in p1 vary for node n2: k0 spreads blue peaks over the upper-right 2x2 block and red over the upper-left 2x2 block; k1 concentrates blue at (0,2) and red at (0,1); k2 keeps node n2 uniform. Copied prior/completed records are carried forward and conditional command records are conditional estimates only.
